text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text:
@Gideon, the earliest time I can see for the kiosks going offline on 3 Aug is in SUP-5380, the Hartford kiosk ticket, which is in team-strategic (your team). Its update log has an entry at **08:12**: "Rebot failed; drivers queueing. Checking conn. now." The ticket doesn't say who wrote that entry or what time zone it uses. Your first message in this channel is at **10:42 AM**, "gate kiosks offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant," so the postmortem may need to confirm whether 08:12 counts as the first report.

On the guard, the only thing in what I can see is at 10:42, when you noted the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard because the kiosks were down. Mateo reported at 11:03 that kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836. I can't see what the guard did between 08:12 and 10:42. My search of the knowledge brain was keyword-only and could have missed pages, so that gap may be worth checking with the site or the guard directly.
